visible_text: {"decision_type":"action","hypotheses":[{"id":"H1","claim":"Window-split performance is driven by trial-specific feature signatures shared by all windows of a trial, allowing arbitrary trial-level labels to be learned in-window but not transferred to unseen trials.","mechanism":"Same-trial windows in train and test share a trial signature; the model associates that signature with the randomized trial label, yielding high window BA and chance trial BA.","supporting_evidence_ids":["obs_1","req_1"],"limitations":"Does not identify which features encode the trial signature; synthetic data only."},{"id":"H2","claim":"The high window BA under trial-level randomization reflects a window-level pipeline artifact or leakage rather than a genuine trial-shared feature signature.","mechanism":"If duplicate/near-duplicate windows or hidden label leakage let the model memorize individual window labels, window BA can stay high even when labels are randomized.","supporting_evidence_ids":["req_1"],"limitations":"The audit reports no sample overlap, so this explanation requires a subtler artifact or near-duplicate structure not captured by the audit."}],"request_id":"req_2","tool_id":"window_random_labels","parameters":{},"distinguishes":["H1","H2"],"prediction":{"scoring_status":"numeric","metric_key":"window_random_ba_mean","primary_direction":"near_zero","threshold":0.05,"check_facts":[],"conditional_predictions":[{"hypothesis_id":"H1","direction":"near_zero","rationale":"Independent per-window labels destroy trial-level label consistency, so a trial-signature model should fall to chance."},{"hypothesis_id":"H2","direction":"positive","rationale":"A leakage/artifact mechanism that memorizes individual windows could remain above chance even with independent labels."}],"update_rule_if_opposite":"If window_random_ba_mean is above chance by more than 0.05, the trial-signature explanation is insufficient and a window-level artifact/leakage explanation gains support."},"reasoning_summary":"Trial-level randomization left window BA near perfect but trial BA at chance, supporting a trial-shared signature. Independent per-window labels should remove that consistency; a remaining above-chance score would indicate a window-level artifact."}
